ios.desc:
GridTravel is the social travel app for explorers who want more than guidebooks. Plan routes, navigate in real time, and tap into a community of travelers sharing the paths they actually walked.

WHY GRIDTRAVEL
• Real routes from real people, not algorithm-generated tourist traps.
• Turn-by-turn GPS navigation built for travelers, not commuters.
• A community of explorers sharing firsthand tips and itineraries.
• Save, share, and create routes for your own adventures.

PLAN YOUR TRIP
• Browse traveler-created routes for cities around the world.
• Build custom multi-stop itineraries with drag-and-drop ease.
• Save points of interest as you discover them.
• See walking times for every stop.

NAVIGATE WITH CONFIDENCE
• Real-time GPS guidance optimized for walking.
• Step-by-step directions between every saved stop.
• Smart rerouting when plans change on the fly.

CONNECT WITH TRAVELERS
• Discover and follow travelers who have the same taste as you.
• Create and share your own custom routes.
• Discover hidden gems through peer recommendations.
• Build a profile that showcases where you've been.

WHO IT'S FOR?
Whether you're a weekend wanderer, a digital nomad, or planning the trip of a lifetime, GridTravel helps you experience destinations the way locals and experienced travelers actually see them.

Download GridTravel and start exploring smarter today.

Have questions or feedback? Reach out to our team at support@gridtravel.app

Privacy Policy: https://www.gridtravel.app/privacypolicy

Terms of Service: https://www.gridtravel.app/terms

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

My co-founders and I have been building GridTravel, a free iOS app for planning and sharing travel routes with turn-by-turn GPS nav. We just launched yesterday after App Store approval.

We're three 21-year-old cofounders and best friends since middle school. We built GridTravel after years of frustration navigating new cities on every trip we took together.

The idea: most people either search Google for "top 10 places to visit in…" lists or go on social media to get inspiration on where to go. GridTravel is built around user-generated routes — actual paths someone walked, that you can follow, save, download, and discover from other travelers. Users also have the ability to create private routes and collaborate with their friends.

Tech stack: Mapbox (Nav SDK + maps), Supabase (auth, DB, storage), and Swift. Native iOS for now, Android coming soon.

Our two real cost drivers are Mapbox Search (hit when users create routes) and Mapbox Navigation (hit when users use live navigation). Both have free tiers, then scale with MAU. We launched fully free to remove the barrier to entry. Revisiting pricing in Year 2 once nav costs start burning a hole in our pocket.

Current state: we're in the UGC cold-start hole. The app's value scales with route density in a given city, but route density requires users, who require routes. Classic chicken and egg. Our current plan:
1. Manually seed 25–30 routes per city, starting with 5-10 priority cities where we have personal networks …
